passage.title: CYCLING TO WORK IN YORK
passage.subtitle: A faster, healthier journey
paragraphs: Two years ago, Tom used to drive his car to the office in the centre of York. However, the morning traffic was terrible, and it often took him forty-five minutes to travel just five kilometres. Finding a parking space near his office was also expensive.

Now, Tom rides his blue bicycle every weekday. He wears a bright yellow helmet and puts his laptop inside a waterproof backpack. He follows a quiet cycle path along the river, so he does not have to ride next to heavy buses or lorries.

The journey by bike only takes Tom eighteen minutes. He says cycling wakes him up better than a cup of strong coffee, and he feels much healthier than before. He saves about eighty pounds a month on petrol and parking tickets.
Only when there is snow or ice on the ground does Tom leave his bike at home and take the train instead. He hopes more people in his office will try cycling this summer.
